mechanics.original_reminder: You may tap a creature you control as you cast this spell. If you do, reduce this spell's mana cost by that creature's power.

rule_text.name: 702.245a
rule_text.rule: “Harness” means “As an additional cost to cast this spell, you may tap an untapped creature you control. This spell costs {X} less to cast, where X is that creature's power.”

rule_text.name: 702.245b
rule_text.rule: The creature tapped this way “harnesses” that spell.
